title: B-tree cached page lookup

scope.rationale: The B-tree core now has the source cache-only lookup that returns null on absence and retains a present page.

external_source_responsibilities: Typed B-tree page cache and retain operation
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete cache-only lookup responsibility is translated.

contracts.ownership: Caller receives one retained reference on success.
contracts.state_and_results: Does not allocate or fetch missing page content.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller holds the shared B-tree mutex; no I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Null means cache miss; state is unchanged on miss.

representation_differences: The typed B-tree cache directly stores Page owners instead of converting a pager DbPage extra area.

oracle.protocol: Look up present and absent page numbers and observe reference counts.
oracle.normalization: Compare page number and reference delta.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O; mutex is a caller invariant.
assurance.continuation: Retained page must be released by caller.
assurance.performance: Linear in current typed page list; pager hash optimization remains separate.

known_blockers: Wire every cache-only caller and focused trace.
